collection.description: A villager counts the gap between the lightning and the thunder as a storm rolls around out at sea.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A storm is rolling around out at sea, a long way off. (subject) has noticed something: after the lightning flashes, there's a gap before the thunder comes. Sometimes a long gap. Sometimes a short one. (subject.He/She) starts counting, under (subject.his/her) breath, between the flash and the rumble.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (friend) has noticed, (friend.he/she) just never thought about it. "Maybe the thunder is slower than the light," (friend.he/she) suggests. "Maybe it walks and the light runs." (subject) likes that very much. They sit under the eaves together, counting and guessing, until the storm drifts off the other way.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: Eight. Seven. Seven. Five. The gaps are getting shorter. "I think the storm's coming closer," (subject) says. (friend) looks at the sky, then at (subject). "How do you know?" "The counting told me." They move the drying fish inside, just in case. A little later, the rain arrives right on time.
